patch_description: This version combines objective-aware greedy construction with a deterministic “pressure repair” neighborhood search. Inspired by the prior multi-start balancing methods, it keeps a small portfolio of high-load, large-model, density, risk, and bucketed construction orders. The novel component is a destroy-and-repair step: it temporarily removes one or two models from a current bottleneck GPU and greedily reinserts them into the whole placement using the full sorted KVPR vector as its objective. This allows coordinated relocations that ordinary single moves and swaps cannot reach because of memory fragmentation. Every repair is accepted only when it lexicographically improves the pressure vector, so the maximum KVPR never worsens.
